title: SCPN Levitated Dipole Core
description: Governed device-family repository for the levitated-dipole configuration within the SCPN Reactor Systems Research Group. Evidence maturity computational_prototype: a validated device configuration model, diagnostic and clock semantics aligned with the SCPN Phase Orchestrator observability catalogue, level-0 device physics of the levitated coil (the coil as a magnet, its levitation, its inductive charging and the confined plasma) in closed form, and tessellated and B-rep models of the coil set in its two arrangements. All parameter sets are synthetic; no real machine is described, and the claim inventory is empty.
